styles.container: max-width: 740px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; font-family: "Playfair Display", "Times New Roman", serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8 !important; color: #0a0a0a; background-color: #f5f5f5; word-wrap: break-word;
styles.innerContainer: background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.95) 0%, rgba(240, 240, 240, 0.95) 100%); border-radius: 12px; padding: 40px; margin: 32px 0; box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15); border: 2px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3); position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: all 0.4s ease;
styles.innerContainer::before: content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #d4af37, transparent); opacity: 0.8;
styles.innerContainer:hover: border-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.6); box-shadow: 0 20px 56px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25); transform: translateY(-2px);

dark-mode.container: max-width: 740px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; font-family: "Playfair Display", "Times New Roman", serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8 !important; color: #f5f5f5; background-color: #0a0a0a; word-wrap: break-word;
dark-mode.innerContainer: background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.95) 0%, rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.95) 100%); border-radius: 12px; padding: 40px; margin: 32px 0; box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25); border: 2px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4); position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: all 0.4s ease;
dark-mode.innerContainer::before: content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #d4af37, transparent); opacity: 0.9;
dark-mode.innerContainer:hover: border-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.7); box-shadow: 0 20px 56px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.35); transform: translateY(-2px);
